items.headline: Albemarle's quarterly profit beats expectations on higher lithium prices
items.snippet: The company reported a net profit of $480 million, or $3.52 per share, in the second quarter, compared with $22.9 million in the same quarter a year ago. Excluding special items, Albemarle posted a profit of $3.75 per share.

items.headline: Here's How to Play Albemarle Stock Before Q2 Earnings Release
items.snippet: Falling lithium market prices are weighing on ALB stock. Lithium prices have pulled back amid slowing demand for electric vehicles in China, an inventory glut and prospects of increased supply.
